Auth.title: Sign in to MAQDAR
Auth.subtitle: Service parts planning for OEMs, distributors and dealer groups.
Auth.magicLinkSent: If {email} has a MAQDAR account, we sent it a sign-in link. Check your inbox.
Auth.invitationOnly: MAQDAR is invitation-only. Ask an administrator of your organization to invite you.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.inviteExpired: This invitation link is invalid, already used or expired. Ask for a new invitation.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.description: Click the button to verify your email address and continue to MAQDAR.
invite.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your invitation email again.

setPassword.title: Set a password
setPassword.description: You can also keep signing in with email links.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Availability, inventory value and demand at a glance.
Dashboard.empty: KPIs appear once transactions are loaded (Step 6).

Items.title: Items

hints.code: Letters, digits and . _ - /, up to 64 characters.
hints.unit_cost: In the item currency, with up to 3 decimals.

Items.deleteWarning: Its supersessions, interchanges and supplier items are deleted with it. An item with demand history cannot be deleted; set its status to Discontinued instead.

Brands.title: Brands
Brands.description: Makes and aftermarket brands that items belong to.

hints.code: Letters, digits and . _ -, up to 64 characters.
hints.country_of_origin: Two-letter ISO code, for example JP or DE.
hints.is_active: Inactive brands stay on the items that use them.

Brands.deleteWarning: A brand that items still use cannot be deleted; mark it inactive instead.

Supersessions.title: Supersessions
Supersessions.description: Part replacements: from the effective date, demand for the replaced part moves to its successor.

hints.predecessor_item_code: Type part of a code or name to see matching items. A part can have only one successor.
hints.successor_item_code: Chains are allowed (A → B → C); a part cannot end up replacing itself.
hints.quantity_factor: Units of the successor per unit of the replaced part, usually 1.

Supersessions.deleteWarning: Demand history stays with the parts; only the replacement link is removed.

Interchanges.title: Interchanges
Interchanges.description: Parts that may be issued for each other, one way or both ways.

hints.alternate_item_code: Type part of a code or name to see matching items. A pair is entered once, in either order.
hints.direction: One way: the alternate may be issued when the part is requested, never the reverse.
hints.priority: 1 to 99; alternates with priority 1 are tried first.

SupplierItems.title: Supplier items
SupplierItems.description: What each supplier sells: lead time, minimum order quantity, pack size and price.

hints.valid_from: Optional. The date the price applies from.
hints.lead_time_days: Planning lead time in calendar days.
hints.lead_time_days_p90: Optional. At least the lead time.
hints.pack_size: Orders are placed in multiples of this quantity.
hints.unit_price: In the price currency, with up to 3 decimals.
hints.is_preferred: A part has one preferred supplier. Choosing this one clears the previous choice.

Locations.title: Locations
Locations.description: Warehouses, regional hubs and branches across the network.
Locations.searchPlaceholder: Search location code, name or city

hints.code: Letters, digits and . _ -, up to 64 characters.
hints.latitude: Decimal degrees from -90 to 90, with up to 6 decimals.
hints.longitude: Decimal degrees from -180 to 180, with up to 6 decimals.
hints.timezone: IANA name, for example Asia/Riyadh. Leave empty to use the country's time zone.
hints.parent_location_id: The location that normally replenishes this one.
hints.work_calendar_id: Leave empty to use the country's weekend and public holidays.
hints.is_active: Mark a closed location inactive instead of deleting it.

Locations.deleteWarning: Its network links and branch-user assignments are deleted with it, and the locations it replenishes lose their parent. A location with demand history cannot be deleted; mark it inactive instead.

NetworkLinks.title: Network links
NetworkLinks.description: Transfer lanes between locations, with lead times and freight cost.

hints.lead_time_days_p50: Calendar days a typical transfer takes, from 0 to 3650.
hints.lead_time_days_p90: Calendar days that 9 in 10 transfers stay within; at least the typical lead time.
hints.freight_cost: Required unless the basis is None, with up to 3 decimals. Ignored when the basis is None.
hints.currency: Required unless the basis is None.

NetworkLinks.deleteWarning: Only the lane is removed; both locations and their parent links stay as they are.

WorkCalendars.title: Work calendars
WorkCalendars.description: Weekend days and public holidays that locations and suppliers work by.

hints.code: Letters, digits and . _ -, up to 64 characters.
hints.country_code: The country whose public holidays apply.
hints.weekend_days: Tick the days that are not worked; at least one day of the week stays a working day.
hints.observe_public_holidays: Closed on the country's public holidays. Needs a country.
hints.is_active: Inactive calendars stay on the locations and suppliers that use them.

WorkCalendars.deleteWarning: Its holiday overrides are deleted with it. A calendar that locations or suppliers use cannot be deleted; mark it inactive instead.

HolidayOverrides.title: Holiday overrides
HolidayOverrides.description: Extra closures and working days for a country or a work calendar.

hints.scope: A country covers every location and supplier there without a calendar of its own; a calendar covers the locations and suppliers that use it.
hints.ends_on: The last day included: the same as From for a single day, and at most 366 days in all.
hints.kind: A closure adds days off; a working day cancels a public holiday or weekend day.

HolidayOverrides.deleteWarning: These days go back to the weekly pattern and public holidays.

Suppliers.title: Suppliers
Suppliers.description: Who parts are bought from: currency, lead times and work calendar.

hints.code: Letters, digits and . _ -, up to 64 characters.
hints.country_code: Two-letter ISO code of the country it ships from, for example CN or DE.
hints.work_calendar_id: Leave empty to use the weekend days and public holidays of its country.
hints.lead_time_days_p50: Calendar days from order to receipt in a typical case.
hints.lead_time_days_p90: Calendar days within which 9 in 10 orders arrive; at least the typical lead time.
hints.is_active: Inactive suppliers keep their supplier items.

Suppliers.deleteWarning: Its supplier items are deleted with it. To keep them, mark the supplier inactive instead.

FxRates.title: Exchange rates
FxRates.description: Conversion rates between currencies, each valid from its date until the next rate of the same pair. Enter a pair in one direction only.

hints.valid_from: Applies from this date until the next rate of the same pair.
hints.rate: Units of the To currency that one unit of the From currency buys, with up to 10 decimals.

Forecasts.title: Forecasts
Forecasts.description: Demand classification, forecast models and planner overrides.

Organizations.title: Your organizations
Organizations.description: Open an organization to continue, or create a new one.
Organizations.empty: You do not belong to an organization yet.
Organizations.emptyHint: Create one, or ask a colleague to invite you.

new.title: Create an organization
new.description: An organization is a tenant: its items, locations, suppliers and demand are isolated from every other organization.
new.name: Name
new.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Derived from the name; it cannot be changed later.

errors.tooMany: You created too many organizations today. Try again tomorrow.

Invitations.mismatchTitle: This invitation is for someone else
Invitations.mismatchDescription: It was sent to a different email address, or it is no longer valid. Sign out and sign in with the invited address, or ask for a new invitation.

Members.title: Members
Members.description: People with access to this organization.
Members.removeConfirmDescription: They lose access immediately. You can invite them again later.
Members.leaveConfirmDescription: You lose access to this organization immediately. An administrator can invite you again later.

InviteMembers.title: Invitations
InviteMembers.description: Invite colleagues by email. Invitations stay open for 7 days; each emailed link works for one hour and can be resent.

errors.cooldown: An invitation to this address was sent less than two minutes ago.
errors.tooMany: This invitation has been sent too many times.
errors.emailRateLimited: The email service is rate-limited right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailNotAuthorized: This address cannot receive email from the current email service.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Name, currency, country and language options.
organization.name: Name
organization.arabicEnabledHint: Members may switch the interface to Arabic. Turning it off makes English the default language again.
organization.readOnly: Only owners and administrators can change these settings.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Default language, time zone and digits for everyone in the organization.
preferences.defaultLocaleHint: Used by members who have not chosen a language themselves.
preferences.defaultLocaleArabicOff: Turn on Arabic under Organization to make it the default language.
preferences.timeZoneHint: Dates and times are shown in this time zone.
preferences.numberingSystemHint: Digits in the Arabic interface. English always uses Latin digits.
preferences.readOnly: Only owners and administrators can change these preferences.

errors.arabicRequired: Turn on Arabic under Organization before making it the default language.
errors.timeZone: Choose a time zone from the list.

language.title: Language
language.description: English is the default. Arabic is available when your organization enables it.
language.disabled: Arabic is switched off for this organization. An administrator can enable it under Organization.

account.title: Account
account.setPasswordDescription: Use a password in addition to email links.

Validation.slugFormat: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
Validation.number: Enter a number, for example 1250.5 or 1,250.5.
Validation.tooManyDigits: Use at most {max} digits before the decimal point.
Validation.codeFormat: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit (up to 64 characters).
Validation.itemCodeFormat: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens and slashes, starting with a letter or digit (up to 64 characters).
Validation.endBeforeStart: Must be on or after the start date.
Validation.p90BelowP50: Must be at least the typical (p50) lead time.
Validation.countryRequired: Choose a country to observe its public holidays.
Validation.rangeTooLong: Use a range of at most {max} days.
